subject: genetics
question: **Type:** application The Human Genome Project was an international effort to determine the sequence of human DNA. Which statement about the project is correct?

options.text: It was completed in 1990 with the sequence of a single human chromosome
It was completed in 1995 with the first complete bacterial genome sequence
It was completed in 2001 with the sequence of the Drosophila genome
It was completed in 2003 with a reference sequence covering the human genome

explanation: The Human Genome Project began in 1990, released a draft of the human sequence in 2001, and completed a reference sequence covering the human genome in 2003. A gives the launch year and only one chromosome. B describes the Haemophilus influenzae genome, the first bacterial genome sequenced, completed in 1995. C describes a Drosophila genome project rather than the human one.
